items.t: "outlooks on what humanity could possibly look like … not off the top of your fucking head … 3.1 is going to be a very optimistic … a very bleak, very dystopian, very pessimistic … one that's kind of rooted in sort of science, and then one rooted in like the absurdity … the maximum amount of it" (the start of the dictation was cut off).
"do all recs … go ahead and do all the builds" (from the car). Chief split the absurd view in two and added a null bound: "just to sort of build the boundaries on this thing".
"Don't file it as Fabula. This is still all research. None of it is … caught in stone … the ideation phase"
Claude filed row 156 in BOLO.md. It is the only record of this work in the sources.
The sources show no outlooks files yet. The views will go in `_tools/bolostatus/work/156/outlooks/`.
Chief's six views: 3.1 optimistic · 3.2 bleak · 3.3 science-rooted · 3.4 absurd, positive at maximum magnitude · 3.5 absurd, negative at maximum magnitude · 3.6 null, past what can be conceived.
Each view says what humanity is like and how it functions. Claude pulls each from published futures sources.
The views file in `_tools/bolostatus/work/156/outlooks/`. They never go to `ssot_04_fabula` or the canon.
BOLO 100 (10/12) set era 5 as the generation ship's journey, provisional. The views feed that far end.

paragraphs.task: Write six sourced views of humanity at the turn of the millennium, from optimistic to null,
paragraphs.intent: in order to set the outer boundaries of the far future before any of it becomes story.
paragraphs.spoken: "3.1 is going to be a very optimistic … a very bleak, very dystopian, very pessimistic … one that's kind of rooted in sort of science … split that ultimate absurd into two different answers … and then one that is absolutely like null … just to sort of build the boundaries on this thing … Don't file it as Fabula. This is still all research."
endstate: Six views sit on one glass, each with its sources and a confidence.
Every claim names its source or carries an extrapolation mark.
The views read as a range: sign and magnitude from 3.1 to 3.6.
Nothing files into the fabula or the canon.
